cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el total de ingresos registrados en caja en marzo de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total FROM cash_movement cm WHERE cm.type = 'INCOME' AND cm.created_at >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND cm.created_at < DATE '2026-04-01' LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cm.amount), 0) AS total_ingresos FROM public.cash_movement AS cm WHERE cm.type = 'INCOME' AND cm.created_at >= CAST('2026-03-01' AS DATE) AND cm.created_at < CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 50
